shortDesc.message: Welcome to Bulk QR Code Generator - app that helps generate qr codes in bulk saving each QR png file.

storeDesc.message:
🤩 Meet Bulk QR Code Generator is a simple yet powerful Chrome extension designed for anyone who needs to create many files quickly, securely, and without effort. With a clean, minimal interface and fast local processing, it helps you generate bulk qr codes directly from text or CSV — right in your browser. ⚡

🔎 If you’ve been searching for an efficient tool, this is your go-to solution. You can bulk generate qr codes from multiline input or structured data, then automatically save all as png images in a neatly organized folder.

▶️ The extension lets you create multiple files at once. You simply type or paste a list of items, links, or contact details, and instantly transform them into high-quality images. Each line becomes one image — an ideal way to make it from link or text without repetitive manual steps.

👷 For professionals, csv mode makes it even easier. You can upload a CSV file, set a custom separator (default “;”), for hundreds of entries at once.

✨ Here’s what makes this extension stand out:
1️⃣ Generate a bunch of files from multiline text input.
2️⃣ Accept CSV input with customizable separators.
3️⃣ Add custom labels using text below and above.
4️⃣ Save all generated items as png images.
5️⃣ Store results automatically inside your Downloads folder.

✅ Whether you’re preparing marketing materials, qr code business card designs, or inventory tags, this app offers full control. It’s simple, private, and reliable — built for both personal and professional use.

🔐 If you value privacy, offline mode lets you work entirely without an internet connection. The extension processes all data locally, keeping your information safe and never uploaded.

▸ Businesses, teachers, and developers appreciate its simplicity:
- Qr code generator bulk usability, but without relying on web servers.
- Fast generation and instant file organization.
- Support for labeling text above or below.
- Clean png output ready for print or sharing.

▸ For many users, this is the best answer to their needs. It removes clutter and focuses on one goal — generating perfectly scannable images, every time.
1. Fast — create hundreds of items in seconds.
2. Efficient — process text or CSV data easily.
3. Organized — saves files automatically in folders.
4. Secure — works fully offline if needed.
5. Simple — clean and minimalistic UI.

💪 From digital projects to event materials, this software handles it all. It can even help you learn how to generate a qr code for different use cases. The extension supports browser generation of any link or text input you provide.

🖨️ Perfect for printing labels, example png exports, or creating documentation samples images, it saves countless hours.

🖌️ Designers and marketers often use bulk qr code generator software free analogues to prepare campaigns or manage product codes. With this extension each generated file comes out as a crisp image, ready to use on websites, packaging, or posters.
If you enjoy simplicity, you’ll find this extension equally intuitive — but optimized for multiple files creation.

🎒 You can even use qr code generator in bulk mode to produce classroom resources, learning links, or assignment identifiers.

🧑‍🏫 For professionals who need scalability, bulk qr code generator keeps things organized while supporting tasks with no data loss. Each session feels natural, lightweight, and efficient.

⚒️ It’s the perfect blend of simplicity and capability — offering the reliability of qr code generator tools with the productivity boost of multiple files creation.

▸ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

❓ How to generate QR codes in bulk?
🟢 Open Bulk QR Code Generator, paste your multiline text, and click generate. Each line becomes one QR image. You can also use CSV input!

❓ Can I use a CSV file instead of text input?
🟢 Yes! CSV mode supports structured files. Just upload your CSV, set a separator, and generate images instantly.

❓ Does it work offline?
🟢 Yes. Everything runs locally in Chrome. Your data is never sent online.

❓ Does it possible to add text on image?
🟢 You can label image using bulk qr code generator with text below and above options to display captions or item names.

❓ Where are the generated files saved?
🟢 All png files are saved in a subfolder within your Downloads directory, automatically organized.

❓ What format are the images?
🟢 They’re exported as png — lightweight and easy to use in printing, docs, or web pages.

❓ Can I make from a link?
🟢 Yes. Simply make it from the link — works perfectly.

❓ Is there any generation limit?
🟢 No strict limit. You can generate hundreds of items, depending on your system performance.

❓ How is this tool different from others?
🟢 Unlike many bulk qr code generator free online qr code websites, this one runs entirely inside Chrome — faster, safer, and always accessible.

❓ Can I use it for business or study?
🟢 Absolutely. From business designs to learning how to make qr codes, this tool fits both professionals and educators.
